original.statement: The spec.otlp.translationStrategy field in monitoring.coreos.com/v1 Prometheus accepts a changed set of enum values; previously accepted values are now rejected by the API server, with UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes added.

decision.reason: The computed diff for the Prometheus v1 schema [ev-cc90e86e2643, ev-c87966ce90d5] lists removed [] and added ["UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes"]: no previously accepted value is rejected, so validation-tightened is wrong. The CRD validator over the same snapshots says the enum is unchanged, which also rules out any tightening. The subject is right, but the evidence conflicts on whether the enum widened at all, and a widening fits no change type in the vocabulary ('added' was refuted because the field already existed). So no correct assertion follows.
